infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: VINTAGE shows the photographs in your library so you can rediscover one and share it. They are read on this iPhone, and nothing is uploaded unless you post it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VINTAGE needs camera access so you can take photographs to share.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VINTAGE needs microphone access when you record short videos.
